c74object.name: bach.jiwheel
c74object.description: The purpose of bach.jiwheel is to act as a simple clock diagram displaying just intonation pitches.

method.name: (mouse)
method.description:
• click: select a pitch
• Shift+click: select a pitch to be used as second extreme of an interval
• click+drag: select an interval
• doubleclick or Alt+click: rotate integer wheel so that number 1 matches a specific pitch

attribute.name: accidentalsfont
attribute.description:
@description Sets the font used to display accidentals. The bach package by default loads the "Bravura" font, developed by Steinberg. The bach package also includes the font "November for bach", created by Robert Piéchaud (www.poeticprocessing.net). "November for bach" is a light version of the famous November font. The full November font covers a wide range of music symbols, from Renaissance to the XXI century, and gives a unique, warm and lively look to your music scores. It is fully compatible with Finale, Sibelius and other notation softwares. You can purchase November from this web address: www.klemm-music.de/notation/november/. Other supported fonts are: Boulez, Maestro, Petrucci, Engraver Font Set.
The accidentals font must be SMUFL-compliant.

attribute.name: accidentalsfontsize
attribute.description: Sets the maximum size of the accidentals (in pt).

attribute.name: alwayswhitekeys
attribute.description: If set, it always displays diatonic "white-keys" pitches with no accidentals (i.e. 'A' through 'G').

attribute.name: autoturn
attribute.description: Toggles the ability to rotate the text for legibility

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: Diagram external background color

attribute.name: boostpythagorean
attribute.description: If set, boosts the importance of purely Pythagorean pitches.

attribute.name: boostwhitekeys
attribute.description: If set, boosts the importance of diatonic "white-keys" pitches, with no accidentals (i.e. 'A' through 'G').

attribute.name: colormode
attribute.description: Sets the color mode.

attribute.name: density
attribute.description: Sets the density of displayed pitches, used when display is in automatic zooming.

attribute.name: direction
attribute.description: Sets the direction for text and accidentals: upright (0), angular (1) or radial (2)

attribute.name: display
attribute.description: Decides what to display: 0 (None), 1 (Ratios) or 2 (Accidentals).

attribute.name: etwheelcolor
attribute.description: Sets the color for the equal temperament wheel.

attribute.name: etwheelsize
attribute.description: Sets the radial size of the equal-temperament wheel.

attribute.name: extendtickstointwheel
attribute.description: Toggles the extension of the pitch ticks to the integers wheel, when they line up.

attribute.name: fifthext
attribute.description: Sets the number of Pythagorean fifths calculated at every side of the basis pitch, used if mode is 1. Leave this to "auto" for automatic zooming.

attribute.name: formaloctave
attribute.description: Sets the harmonic ratio corresponding to the formal octave (defaults to 2: actual octave)

attribute.name: hidecollisions
attribute.description: Toggles the ability to hide labels when colliding with others

attribute.name: importance
attribute.description: Sets the formula defining how important is each fraction. You can use as variables "num" (numerator), "den" (denominator), "min" (min between the two), "max" (max between the two), "limit" (prime limit of the fraction), and "maxexp" (largest power of each limit > 2).

attribute.name: inset
attribute.description: Inset of the clock diagram with respect to the border, in pixels

attribute.name: intwheeldensity
attribute.description: Sets the density of integers in the integers wheel, used when display is in automatic zooming.

attribute.name: intwheelpitchestofront
attribute.digest: Move Pitches Coinciding with Integers Wheel to Front
attribute.description: If set, it prioritize pitches coinciding with integer wheel numbers, moving them to the front.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Move Pitches Coinciding with Integers Wheel to Front

attribute.name: intwheelsize
attribute.description: Sets the radial size of the integers wheel.

attribute.name: jibase
attribute.description: Sets the diatonic pitch corresponding to the 1/1 ratio (as one of the letters A through G).

attribute.name: jicommas
attribute.description: Sets the Just Intonation commas used if mode is 1. Leave this to "auto" for automatic zooming (and tailor the density attribute in this case).

attribute.name: jilimit
attribute.description: The jilimit attributes allows you to set a maximum just intonation limit for an interval (as frequency ratio) showing up in the output. (0 means: any, which is the default.)

attribute.name: jiprimes
attribute.description: Sets the allowed primes for the displayed pitches. Leave "any" to unconstrain. Use the less or equal sign as first symbol to select limits less or equal to a certain number. Notice that this is slightly different than limits: when using limits one is constraining the highest prime appearing in the ratio, while when using primes one is constraining _all_ the primes appearing in the ratio.

attribute.name: legendcolor
attribute.description: Sets the color for the legend.

attribute.name: legendfont
attribute.description: Chooses the font used for the legend.

attribute.name: legendfontsize
attribute.description: Sets the legend size (in pt).

attribute.name: mapping
attribute.description: Sets the mapping: either linear in pitch (0) or linear in frequency (1)

attribute.name: maxterm
attribute.description: Sets the maximum term used if mode is 0. Leave this to "auto" for automatic zooming (and tailor the density attribute in this case).

attribute.name: maxtermintwheel
attribute.description: Sets the maximum number in the integers wheel. Leave this to "auto" for automatic zooming.

attribute.name: minfactor
attribute.description: Sets the minimum reduction factor for importance.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: Sets the representation mode: either up to a maximum term for numerator/denominator (0) or by combining just intonation commas (1). In the first case, see maxterm. In the second, see fifthext and commas.

attribute.name: out
attribute.description:
The out attribute is a sequence of characters identifying the outlet types (one character for each llll outlet). Characters can be one of the following:
n (default): 'native' output: faster and more precise between bach objects, but unreadable by standard Max objects (an "bach.llll" message appears instead).
t: 'text' output: slower and limited in size, but readable by standard Max objects. A plain llll in text format is a generic Max message. To keep the representation invertible (i.e., to allow a bach object receiving a text-format llll to interpret it exactly as if it was native format, except for the size limitation), some specific kinds of symbols are preceded by a backtick: namely, symbols containing parens, or containing textual representations of numbers or pitches, or beginning with a backtick, plus the symbols "null" and "nil" (distinct from the reserved words "null" and "nil" representing the empty list and the empty sublist) are preceded by a backtick. Moreover, the symbols "int", "float" or "list" are preceded by a backtick only if they are the first element of an llll, to distinguish them from the corresponding reserved messages of Max.
m: 'max' output: mostly equivalent to the "t" specifier, but no symbol is backticket except "int", "float" and "list" at the beginning of an llll. It is important to notice that, differently from text-format lllls proper, Max-format lllls might not be invertible even if they do not reach the size limit for Max message. This means that a bach object receiving a Max-format llll output from another bach object might interpret it differently from the original, or in some cases might even reject it.
x: disabled output (nothing is output)
p: 'portal' output: only used by bach.portal to intercept the @out attribute specified while creating the abstraction (see bach.portal).
The native output is recommended, unless communication with standard Max messages is needed. Disabling unused outputs can be useful if extreme optimization of the patch is needed.

attribute.name: outputmode
attribute.description: Sets the output mode: none (0), pitches from the first outlet (1), pitches from the first outlet along with details on the second outlet (2)

attribute.name: outputoctave
attribute.description: Sets the output octave

attribute.name: rotationangle
attribute.description: Sets the rotation angle (in radians).

attribute.name: selectioncolor
attribute.description: Sets the color for selection in RGBA format.

attribute.name: showcircles
attribute.description: Toggles the display of the circles

attribute.name: showetwheel
attribute.description: Toggles the display of the equal temperament wheel as a reference

attribute.name: showfocus
attribute.description: Show that the object has the focus by increasing the width of the border.

attribute.name: showintwheel
attribute.description: Toggles the display of the integers wheel

attribute.name: showlegend
attribute.description:
Chooses if and where the legend should be displayed: - Never: no legend is ever shown.
- Only For Selection: only selection legend is displayed. Selection legend is located in the upper left corner of the notation object, and is shown whenever a single notation item (e.g. a note) is selected.
- Always: in addition to selection legend, also the mouseover legend is displayed. Mouseover legend is located in the bottom right corner of the notation object, and is shown whenever the mouse moves over the notation object.

attribute.name: showticks
attribute.description: Toggles the display of the ticks

attribute.name: ticklength
attribute.description: Sets the maximum tick length.

attribute.name: zoom
attribute.description: Zoom percentage.

attribute.name: zoomangle
attribute.description: Sets the zoomed angle (in radians).
